title: CalorTracker Food Nutrition Dataset (USDA-derived)
subtitle: Calories, macros and vitamins per 100 g plus household portions, from USDA.
description:
461 common foods with nutrients per 100 g and household portions, taken from USDA FoodData Central and keyed by FDC id and CalorTracker page slug.

Version 2026-11-18. CC0 1.0. Source: USDA FoodData Central (https://fdc.nal.usda.gov/). Derived and cleaned by CalorTracker (https://calortracker.com/nutrition). API: https://calortracker.com/developers.

resources.description: One row per food: identity, USDA source and 31 nutrients per 100 g.
USDA household portions per food, with their weight in grams.
The same foods as nested JSON: nutrients in per100g, portions as an array.
